start.description:
In case of incremental normalization, the start date at which data needs to start normalizing
For full normalization this will be null

end.description:
In case of incremental normalization, the end date at which data needs to end normalizing
For full normalization this will be null

interval.description:
If normalization interval is already known, in case of manual override or incremental normalization,
this parameter will be set

_size.description: length of this time-info in intervals. I.e. size of the timeseries this info represents.

_isAligned.description: true if time range is aligned with interval.

header.description: Instance of time series header obj

tsField.description: Timeseries field for which normalization is desired

title: This type will hold options / properties to be passed to the normalizer
name: TSNormalizationSpec
